subsection.name: Introduction
subsection.p: This library provides services to communicate with ShortUrlPlugin using REST.

subsection.name: Services
subsection.p: The main service is fr.paris.lutece.plugins.shorturl.service.ShortUrlClientService which provides methods to call ShortUrlPlugin.

subsection.name: Configuration with a CDI producer
subsection.p: Define the server base url when the client and the shorturl plugin are not in the same webapp. Without it, the client calls the webapp of the current request.
